devices.label: 7302 ISAM DSLAM (48-port VDSL2 LT)
devices.description: Nokia/Alcatel-Lucent 7302 ISAM 16-slot copper access node. This spec models one 48-line VDSL2 LT line card in slot 1 (ports 1/1/1-48, VDSL2 17a/8b, 100 Mbps class) plus the four GE uplinks carried on the ECNT-C network-termination board (3x GE optical SFP + 1x GE optical/RJ45 combo) = 52 ports. The shelf takes up to 16 LTs and, with a 48b-bonding card, 100+ Mbps per line.
devices.notes: ECNT-C NT board: four GE links on the front panel, 3x GE optical SFP plus 1x GE optical/electrical selectable. LT cards are 48 lines each (16 LT slots).

devices.label: 7330 ISAM FTTN node (48-port VDSL2 LT)
devices.description: Nokia/Alcatel-Lucent 7330 ISAM FTTN, the compact 19-inch 10-slot cabinet/remote variant of the ISAM family. Counted here: one 48-line VDSL2 LT card shared with the 7302 (ports 1/1/1-48, 17a/8b with vectoring and pair bonding) plus the four GE uplinks on the NANT controller (2x GE SFP + 1x GE SFP + 1x GE SFP/RJ45 combo) = 52 ports. The 7330 can subtend up to 24 sealed remote modules.
devices.notes: 7330 shelf: up to 10 slots for DSL / P2P fibre / aggregation modules, same ISAM LT cards as the 7302 (48 lines per LT). NANT: 2 SFP user/network/subtending links plus 1 GE optical SFP and 1 switchable GE SFP/RJ45.

devices.label: SmartAX MA5600T DSLAM (H805VDMF 48-port VDSL2)
devices.description: Huawei SmartAX MA5600T 16-service-slot all-in-one copper/fibre access platform. Counted here: one H805VDMF 48-port VDSL2-over-POTS board in slot 1 (ports 0/1/0-47, VDSL2 17a/8b, MELT, G.INP, ADSL2+ backwards compatible) plus the SCUN control board's 4x GE optical uplinks (SFP) = 52 ports. An H801X2CS uplink board adds 2x 10GE SFP+ and 64-port VDPD/VDQM boards raise the line side to 64.
devices.notes: SCUN provides four GE upstream optical ports (SFP). Board table: 48-channel VDSL2 boards VDJM (over ISDN), VDMF/VCMM (over POTS), VSNL/VSNF splitters.

devices.label: SmartAX MA5616 mini-DSLAM (H83BCVLE 32-port VDSL2)
devices.description: Huawei SmartAX MA5616 2U multi-dwelling-unit box that doubles as a mini-DSLAM/MSAN. Counted here: one H83BCVLE 32-channel VDSL2 + POTS combo board (ports 0/1/0-31, profiles up to 17a, 600-ohm embedded splitters, vectoring/ SuperVector) plus the 2x GE SFP uplinks on the upstream board = 34 ports. GPON uplink variants swap those two GE cages for 2x GPON.
devices.notes: MA5616 offers two GPON or two GE upstream ports. VDSL2 boards: H83BCVLE 32-ch VDSL2+POTS combo, H835VDGE 16-ch over POTS, H835VDTH 24-ch over ISDN; ADSL2+ boards up to 64-ch (H836ADPE). Subscriber connector is Champ 64-pin.

devices.label: FSAP 9800 IP-DSLAM (48-line VDSL2 card)
devices.description: ZTE FSAP 9800 full-service IP-DSLAM with a total-GE backplane. Counted here: one 48-line VDSL2 card (VINK/VSNV, ports 1-1-1-1 to 1-1-1-48, G.993.2 Annex A/B, 100 Mbps symmetric class) plus the CSC control/switch card's 6x GE uplinks (optical and electrical uplink sub-cards) = 54 ports. The 64-line VNVNA VDSL2 card and four 2xGE Ethernet cards push the shelf higher.
devices.notes: FSAP 9800: VDSL2 cards of 48 or 64 lines, ADSL2/2+ cards of 32/64 lines. Uplinks: 6x GE on the CSC board (2 sub-cards, electrical/optical mix) and up to 4 Ethernet cards with 2x GE each, i.e. 14 GE maximum; FE/GE/10GE/ATM network interfaces.

devices.label: ZXDSL 9806H mini-DSLAM (24-port ADSL2+ card)
devices.description: ZTE ZXDSL 9806H 2U mini-DSLAM: one control & switching slot plus four line-card slots, 96 ADSL2+ or 64 VDSL2 lines fully loaded. Counted here: one 24-port ADSL2+ over POTS card (ports 1-1-1-1 to 1-1-1-24, 24 Mbps class, Annex A/M) plus the SCCB card's 2x GE uplink/subtending ports = 26 ports. A VDSL2 build uses 16-port VSTDC cards instead.
devices.notes: 9806H: 4 user slots; 24-port ADSL/ADSL2+ card, 16-port VDSL2 card, 24-port SHDSL card. SCCB control card gives 2x GE/FE electrical/fibre uplink, or 1x GE + 1x GPON/EPON with an uplink subcard.

devices.label: C7 multiservice access platform (ADSL2-24 card)
devices.description: Calix C7 multiservice access platform with 20 universal line-card slots (up to 2,400 ADSL lines per 7-foot bay). Counted here: one ADSL2-24 plug-in card (ports 1/1-1/24, 24 Mbps ADSL2+/Annex M, G.992.5, ATM PVC per line over rear RJ-21) plus the GE-2p/FE-4p uplink card 2x GE SFP optical + 4x 10/100BaseT = 30 ports. VDSL2 builds use the E3-48C style 48-port combo cards.
devices.notes: ADSL2-24: 24 ADSL ports per card, up to 20 cards per 14-inch C7 shelf. Uplinks come from the GE-2p / GE-2p-FE-4p card: 2x GE on front-panel SFPs plus 4x 10/100BaseT through the rear RJ-21 adaptor.

devices.label: E3-48C sealed ESAN (48 combo VDSL2/POTS)
devices.description: Calix E3-48C sealed Ethernet Service Access Node for pole, pedestal and cabinet FTTN deployments. The sealed unit is itself the fixed line assembly: 48 combo VDSL2/ADSL2+ + POTS subscriber ports (17a/8b with ADSL2+ fallback, bonding and vectoring-capable), plus 2x 10GE/1GE SFP+ and 3x 1GE/2.5GE SFP uplinks = 53 ports. Pairs with B-, C- and E-series shelves; up to two 10GE and four 2.5/1GE feeds per chassis.
devices.notes: E3-48C: 48x combo DSL and POTS ports, two 1GE/2.5GE SFP MSA sockets and two 1GE/10GE SFP+ MSA sockets. The three 1GE cages are 2.5GE-capable (modelled at 1G here because the SFP cage media set tops out at 1000BASE-X).

devices.label: Total Access 1148V vectored VDSL2 node
devices.description: ADTRAN Total Access 1148V sealed, span- or locally-powered vectored VDSL2 FTTC/FTTN node. Counted here: 48 ports of vectored VDSL2 with integrated POTS splitters (17a, 100 Mbps service class, board- and system-level vectoring to 192 ports across four nodes) plus 4x 1/2.5/10GE SFP uplinks = 52 ports. T1/EoDMT bonded-copper backhaul variants exist for reach-limited sites.
devices.notes: 1148V: 48 ports vectored VDSL2 + POTS with integrated splitters, 4x 1/2.5/10GE SFP interfaces, ERPS G.8032 ring, non-blocking 10GE switching. The 2.5GE rate is modelled inside the SFP+ cage's 1G/10G capability.

devices.label: MileGate 2310 subrack (SUV51 48-port VDSL2 card)
devices.description: KEYMILE (now DZS) MileGate 2310 4U subrack: 8 slots, 7 usable for service line cards, 2 for redundant core units, 336 VDSL2 lines fully loaded. Counted here: one MileGate SUV51 48-port VDSL2 over POTS/ISDN line card (ports 1/1/1-48, 8/12/17 MHz profiles, board-level vectoring for all 48 lines, system-level vectoring to 384) plus the 40G core unit's 2x 40GE QSFP+ and 3x 10GE SFP+ uplinks = 53 ports.
devices.notes: SUV51: 48-port VDSL2 line card, 8/12/17 MHz, board-level vectoring of 48 lines, MELT/DELT/SELT, 1/10 Gbps backplane. MileGate 2310/2510 core unit offers two 40GE (QSFP+) and three 10GE (SFP+) uplinks; 2310 supports up to 336 VDSL2 ports, 2510 up to 960.
